decision.reasoning_trace: My consideration set focused on actual backpacks, filtering out the large number of irrelevant items in the feed such as tents, stoves, and dog shirts. I evaluated the KAILAS 28L for its lightweight frame and the Maxpedition for its high quality. The Mardingtop provided a high-capacity option, while the Warriors and Dynamic Discs bags covered budget-tactical and hobby-specific needs. However, the feed was highly cluttered with non-backpack products, and the specific backpacks available were either too specialized (disc golf/baseball) or lacked enough user reviews to justify the price points offered. I decided not to make a purchase during this session as none of the options perfectly met my criteria for a general-purpose hiking or travel backpack.
